sponsorLevels.name: Presenting Partner
sponsorLevels.summary: Underwrite a year of programming across every chapter.

description: A partnership level with its benefits as a repeatable list — rows an organizer can add, reorder, and delete. This is the state that was not merely unedited before but INEXPRESSIBLE: a level carries a benefits list inside the list of levels, and the editor supports a repeatable list of scalars at top level only, so a list inside a list had no control that could render it. Splitting levels into their own collection is what made the inner list a top-level one. Note the warning on Level ID: renaming the display Name is always safe, while changing the ID re-homes every sponsor filed under it into Other partners.
